 ...RESPONDENTS

THIS MFA FILED U/S.173(1) OF MV ACT, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 09.02.2022 PASSED IN MVC NO.833/2019 ON THE FILE OF THE III ADDITIONAL DISTRICT JUDGE AND MACT, MYSURU, AWARDING COMPENSATION OF RS.44,636/- WITH INTEREST AT 6 PERCENT P.A. FROM THE DATE OF PETITION TILL THE DATE OF REALIZATION.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT Learned advocate for the appellant submits that the statutory deposit has to be made in the appeal and inspite of reminders, the appellant is not coming forward to NC: 2023:KHC:37605 deposit the same.
He further submits that he has no instruction to go on with the matter.
For that reason, appeal stands dismissed for non- prosecution.
